edit.invalidPhone: Please enter a valid phone number (e.g. 0170 1234567).

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.successMessage: Your password has been changed successfully.

deleteAccount.heroSubtitle: This action is irreversible and cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.whatHappensTitle: What happens when you delete your account?
deleteAccount.whatHappensBullet1: Your sign-in account (email and password) will be permanently removed.
deleteAccount.whatHappensBullet2: Your profile (name, phone number, push token) will be deleted.
deleteAccount.whatHappensBullet3: You'll be signed out immediately and lose access to the app.
deleteAccount.remainingDataBullet1: Jobs, comments, and photos you created or edited remain with your company for operational and legal reasons.
deleteAccount.remainingDataBullet2: As your employer, your company may retain employment or working-time records for the period required by legal obligations. Your other account data will be deleted.
deleteAccount.adminNote: Your company will remain because it has other active administrators. Only your own account will be deleted.
deleteAccount.checkboxLabel: I understand this action is irreversible and my account will be permanently deleted.
deleteAccount.confirmDialogMessage: This action cannot be undone. Your account and profile will be permanently deleted.
deleteAccount.genericError: Your account could not be deleted. Please try again later.
deleteAccount.contextError: Your account information could not be loaded. Please check your internet connection and try again.
deleteAccount.lastAdminChangedMessage: Your role in the company has changed. Please review the information shown and confirm again.

company.heroSubtitle: You are the only active administrator of “{{company}}”. Deleting your account also deletes the company. This cannot be undone.
company.bulletAccount: Your sign-in account and your profile.
company.bulletCompany: The company “{{company}}” and all company data.
company.bulletData: All jobs, working times, absences, vacation balances, comments, photos and other company data.
company.bulletEmployees: All other accounts of the company (employees and deactivated administrators): {{count}}. They lose access immediately.
company.bulletNoEmployees: The company has no other accounts.
company.checkboxCompanyLabel: I understand that the company “{{company}}” and all company data will be permanently deleted and all company accounts will lose access.
company.confirmDialogMessage: Your account, the company, all company data (including working times and absences) and all employee accounts will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
company.exportText: As an employer, you may have statutory retention duties for employment and working-time records. Download the recorded working times before deleting. TaskOps does not keep a copy after deletion.
company.exportFailed: The export could not be created. Please check your internet connection and try again.
company.acknowledgeLabel: I understand that I am responsible for any statutory retention obligations for my company records.
company.notExportedWarning: You have not downloaded the work-time records yet.

export.pdfScope: Export of the working times recorded in TaskOps Manager (work sessions and recorded job times). Absences, notes, comments and photos are not included.
